facts: A single vehicle collision with a boundary wall occurred, causing front end damage.
The loss occurred on 2026-07-02 and was intimated on 2026-07-06, four days after the occurrence.
The insured reported being hospitalized for two days following the incident.

wording.citation: END-2026-01 v1.0 (effective 2026-04-01) — Endorsement 1 to the Private Car Package Policy > 3. Amendment to Clause 2.3 — Constructive total loss threshold [resolved against loss date 2026-07-02]
wording.why: Specifies that claim intimation must be given within 72 hours of occurrence, amending the earlier 48-hour requirement.
wording.excerpt:
## 3. Amendment to Clause 2.3 — Constructive total loss threshold

The constructive total loss threshold in Clause 2.3 is reduced from 75% to **70% of the
IDV**. A claim where the aggregate cost of retrieval and repair exceeds 70% of the IDV is
therefore treated as a total loss.

The remaining provisions of Clause 2.3 are unchanged: the IDV is paid in full, depreciation
does not apply, and salvage

referral.reason: The claim was intimated four days after the loss, whereas Endorsement 1 specifies a 72-hour intimation timeframe. The adjuster should consider whether the reported hospitalization affects the intimation timeframe compliance.

packet.summary_for_adjuster: The claim involves front end damage from a single vehicle collision with a boundary wall on 2026-07-02, reported four days later on 2026-07-06. Endorsement 1 amends Clause 4 to require claim intimation within 72 hours of the occurrence. The adjuster should review the intimation condition in light of the insured's two-day hospitalization.
